data.title: Customs seize 1,000 Apple phones
data.description: TAK: Customs officers have seized 1,000 second-hand Apple phones worth more than 7 million baht suspected of being smuggled into Myanmar.

data.title: Two drug suspects killed in shootout with police in Phetchaburi
data.description: PHETCHABURI - Two suspected drug smugglers were killed and 500 kilogrammes of crystal methamphetamine seized following an exchange of gunfire with narcotics suppression police in Khao Yoi district on Tuesday night.

data.title: Parts of Bangkok and 19 provinces remain flooded
data.description: Floods persisted in parts of Bangkok and 19 provinces, mostly in the Central Plains, on Wednesday, according to the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation.

data.title: Customs seize 1k Apple phones
data.description: TAK: Customs officers have seized 1,000 second-hand Apple phones worth more than 7 million baht suspected of being smuggled into Myanmar.

data.title: Aussie job scam hits Thais
data.description: Victims of an alleged Australian job scam have filed a complaint with the Anti-Trafficking in Persons Division, seeking an urgent investigation into losses exceeding 10 million baht.

data.title: Europe unrest spurs warning
data.description: Thai embassies in Europe have warned Thai nationals to remain vigilant amid planned protests linked to the cost of living, employment and education, urging them to avoid high-risk areas and monitor local advisories.

data.title: AG issues guidelines for reviewing amnesty cases
data.description: The attorney-general has issued guidelines for prosecutors nationwide to review cases potentially eligible for political amnesty under the Peaceful Society Promotion Act 2026, with eligible cases to be terminated in accordance with the law.

data.title: China study trip 'fraud' sparks probe
data.description: Education Minister Prasert Jantararuangtong has ordered a seven-day investigation into an alleged case of fraud involving a China study trip and an Obec official who left 62 students and eight teachers stranded, causing 2.4 million baht in losses.

data.title: Facebook accounts for 74% of online shopping scams
data.description: Facebook accounted for nearly three-quarters of reported online shopping scams in Thailand last week, with clothing, vehicles and travel services the most targeted categories, the Anti Cyber Scam Center (ACSC) reported.

data.title: Flood victims to get B10.5bn
data.description: The cabinet has approved 10.5 billion baht in central budget funding for fiscal 2027 to compensate flood victims, as the government introduces financial, tax and insurance measures to help affected households, farmers and businesses.

data.title: Campus shift plans set to go ahead
data.description: Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation Minister Yodchanan Wongsawat has confirmed plans to relocate Uthenthawai Campus despite student protests, pledging support to minimise disruption during the 90-day transition.

data.title: Potash mines aim to cut import reliance
data.description: The Industry Ministry is pushing potash mining projects to reduce dependence on fertiliser imports and generate more than 30 billion baht in annual export revenue.

data.title: Court hears witnesses in ethics case of former Move Forward Party MPs
data.description: Three witnesses testified at the Supreme Court on Tuesday in a case against 44 former Move Forward Party MPs accused of serious ethical violations for co-sponsoring a proposal to amend Section 112 of the Criminal Code, the lese-majeste law.

data.title: Illegal waste factories face crackdown
data.description: The government is coordinating efforts across ministries to crack down on illegal industrial waste operations in Prachin Buri, amid concerns over toxic pollution and forest encroachment.

data.title: Civil groups urge PM to drop 4 tax bills
data.description: Ten civil society networks have urged Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul to withdraw four proposed bills after public consultations indicated strong opposition to changes in earmarked tax funding.

data.title: Fugitive tied to B220m theft collared
data.description: Immigration police have arrested a 41-year-old Chinese businessman wanted in his home country for alleged fraud and theft involving about 220 million baht, with more than 100 victims in Beijing.

data.title: Seoul eyes closer ties in AI, content
data.description: Thailand and South Korea could expand cooperation in artificial intelligence (AI) to improve logistics, automotive manufacturing and tourism services, speakers at a bilateral forum said on Tuesday.

data.title: Klatham future prompts rumours
data.description: The possibility of the Klatham Party joining the Bhumjaithai-led coalition after next week's no-confidence debate has fuelled speculation about a cabinet reshuffle.

data.title: B44m seized in gambling case against MP Chonnaput
data.description: The Anti-Money Laundering Office (Amlo) has seized an additional 44 million baht in cash and digital assets linked to an online gambling network in which Klatham Party MP Chonnaput Naksua is accused of being a key figure.

data.title: Dinosaur footprints dating back 120 million years confirmed in Udon Thani
data.description: Paleontologists have confirmed that six fossilized footprints found in Udon Thani were left by a carnivorous dinosaur about 120 million years ago, and the site will be protected and developed for scientific study and tourism.
